snippet.title: RTS will never be the same after this...
snippet.description:
We found something that will change Conquest of Eldinar forever.

👉Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2548280/Conquest_of_Eldinar/
👉Visit our website: https://www.mythwardentertainment.com/

Conquest of Eldinar is a 3D Real Time Strategy and Action game where you choose from one of 16 different epic fantasy Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in thrilling large scale battles in campaign mode or in competitive online multiplayer matches.

👉Join our Discord Server:     https://discord.com/invite/UYej2Jev4q
You can follow updates on the game and see all sorts of cool sneak peeks.
